title: WPMS/2769/2019 of RAJESH KUMAR Vs APPELLATE AUTHORITY DIRECTOR DEFENSE ESTATE

paras.text:
MCC No.241/2020 (Time Extension Application)
In
WPMS No.2769 of 2019
Hon'bleSudhanshu Dhulia, J.
Mr. Pankaj Goswami, Advocate for the
petitioner.
Mr. Sanjay Bhatt, Advocate for respondent
no. 2.
The petitioner admittedly has an
accommodation in a cantonment area, which is the
property of the Cantonment Board.
On 16.09.2019, the writ petition was disposed
of by this Court by giving the petitioner time till
31.12.2019 to vacate the premises. The petitioner,
however, did not vacate the premises, but moved a
time extension application before this Court for
extension of time. Again the time was extended by
this Court vide order dated 19.12.2019 till
31.03.2020 and the petitioner was directed to vacate
the premises on or before 31.03.2020. The petitioner
did not vacate the premises and yet again moved
another time extension application for extension of
time. This application of the petitioner was
dismissed by this Court on 13.03.2020.
Now the petitioner has filed another time
extension application being MCC No. 241 of 2020
before this Court praying that some more time be
granted to the petitioner to vacate the premises.
Since this Court has already granted extension
to the petitioner, there is no occasion to interfere in
the matter as the last application of the petitioner for
extension of time has already been rejected.
Consequently, the time extension application
stands dismissed.
